name: sign_by_bed
caption: which sign do I TRUST? 😳
premise: In this world every player finds a sign from their future self on their first night. It saved my cousin from lava and my friend from a creeper. Mine says DON'T OPEN THE CHEST UNDER YOUR BED, but I never placed a chest. Mom stands in the doorway smiling and doesn't blink. I lock the door, something knocks from inside the chest, and a second sign appears inside the locked room in my handwriting: OPEN IT. THAT ISN'T MOM. SHE'S IN THE CHEST. It spells my name wrong.
answer: Sign 1. Part 2: villagers never blink (that clue is just Minecraft), and the thing in the chest wrote sign 2: it can put signs through walls but has never seen my name written down. Clues for 1: sign 2 appeared through a locked door, it misspells my name, the knocking starts right after I lock the door. Clues for 2: sign 1 stood by the door where only Mom could reach, Mom never blinks, the chest knocks back. Shared clue: sign 2 is in my handwriting (proof it's me, or proof something has been watching me write).

lines.text: In my world, / EVERY player / finds a SIGN / from their FUTURE self / on their FIRST night.
My cousin's / said, DON'T / DIG DOWN. / Under him / was LAVA.
My friend's / said, SLEEP / in the HAY. / That night / a CREEPER / blew up / her BED.
DON'T OPEN / the CHEST / under / your BED.
The sign / was by / the DOOR. / Right where / MOM stands.
She was / SMILING. / She hasn't / BLINKED / all night.
And a / SECOND sign / was on / the wall. / INSIDE / my locked room.
OPEN IT. / That isn't / MOM. / She's in / the CHEST.
But it / spelled / my name / WRONG.
